title: 2021 COVID-19 micro-business grant – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for the 2021 COVID-19 micro-business grant.
who_can_apply: The terms and conditions apply to businesses that were impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic.

The grant is subject to specific definitions regarding religious institutions and practitioners, including those who were at imminent risk of closure, unable to pay operating expenses, and/or forced to reduce employee headcount.
